test_title: PYST 55: SSC GD Constable 2022 - English (Held On : 02 Feb 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Most often, child labour occurs when families ______ financial challenges or uncertainty - whether due to poverty, sudden illness of a caregiver or job loss of a primary wage earner.
solution: The correct answer is **"face."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Face"** means to confront or deal with a difficult situation. (अप्रिय स्थिति का सामना करना; कठिन परिस्थिति में किसी व्‍यक्ति से निबटना) • **Example**:* I can't **face**__ another difficulty.* • It is the most appropriate option in the given context, as child labour is often a result of families facing financial challenges. • The sentence is in the present tense, so the verb form **"face" **is correct. • The correct answer is Option 1. **Correct sentence**:* Most often, child labour occurs when families __**face**__ financial challenges or uncertainty - whether due to poverty, sudden illness of a caregiver or job loss of a primary wage earner. * [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 2, "emulate,"** means to imitate or copy. (किसी के बराबर होने या उससे आगे बढ़ने की चेष्‍टा करना) • **Option 3, "contend,"** means to struggle or compete. (समस्‍या या मुश्किल परिस्थिति का सामना करना) • **Option 4, "happen,"** means to occur or take place. ((किसी घटना या स्थिति का) घटित हो जाना (बिना किसी पूर्व योजना के)) 33:T7c3, The correct answer is **"beating."**
